name: ChemBERTa-3
condition: Reconsider after platform/framework scope and explicit reuse terms for the released framework and model artifacts are verified.
licence_quote: Repository LICENSE (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/deepforestsci/chemberta3/main/LICENSE): "MIT License / Permission is hereby granted, free of charge, to any person obtaining a copy of this software and associated documentation files (the \"Software\"), to deal in the Software without restriction, including without limitation the rights to use, copy, modify, merge, publish, distribute, sublicense, and/or sell copies of the Software". Model-card front matter on https://huggingface.co/DeepChem/MoLFormer-c3-1.1B/raw/main/README.md and https://huggingface.co/DeepChem/ChemBERTa-100M-MLM/raw/main/README.md: "license: mit" (HF API also returns tag "license:mit" and cardData.license = "mit" for both). Journal article itself is under CC BY-NC 3.0 per Crossref licence field (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc/3.0/) - that covers the article, not the software.
rationale: Both halves of the condition are now satisfied from primary sources fetched today. (1) Scope: the work is peer-reviewed and published - Crossref CSL JSON for DOI 10.1039/D5DD00348B returns title "ChemBERTa-3: an open source training framework for chemical foundation models", container-title "Digital Discovery", volume 5, issue 2, pages 662-685, created 2026-01-19, publisher Royal Society of Chemistry, and the deposited abstract reads "An overview of ChemBERTa-3, an open-source training and benchmarking framework designed to train and fine-tune large-scale chemical foundation models" - i.e. the platform/training-framework classification the record already carries (modality "platform") is confirmed by the published primary source, not inferred. (2) Terms: GitHub API for deepforestsci/chemberta3 returns license.spdx_id "MIT" and the repo root contains a LICENSE file whose text is verbatim MIT (quoted above); repo last pushed 2026-07-23. The released model artifacts named in the repo README ("The pretrained models are also available on the Hugging Face Hub at https://huggingface.co/DeepChem") carry MIT in their card front matter: DeepChem/MoLFormer-c3-1.1B (created 2025-06-13, lastModified 2026-02-25, files include model.safetensors and deepchem_ckpt.pt, ungated) and DeepChem/ChemBERTa-100M-MLM (created 2025-05-09, lastModified 2025-08-18, files include model.safetensors, ungated). The MoLFormer-c3-1.1B card also cites the journal version: "ChemBERTa-3: An Open Source Training Framework for Chemical Foundation Models. RSC Digital Discovery 2026; doi:10.1039/D5DD00348B". CAVEATS the catalog should carry: (a) DeepChem/MoLFormer-c3-550M and DeepChem/MoLFormer-c3-100M currently contain only README.md and .gitattributes - no weight files - so only the 1.1B c3-MoLFormer and ChemBERTa-100M-MLM are verified downloadable weights; (b) the older DeepChem/ChemBERTa-10M-MLM (2022) carries no licence declaration and should not be cited as a ChemBERTa-3 artifact; (c) the record's paper_link should be upgraded from the ChemRxiv PDF to the DOI. Release dates: framework artifacts on HF 2025-05-09 / 2025-06-13; journal version 2026-01-19.

rationale: Material change since the last review, but not enough to clear the provenance bar. Fetched today: the arXiv abs page for 2502.10807 (Microsoft Research AI for Science authorship; comments field gives the official project page); the official project page https://hybridna-project.github.io/HybriDNA-Project/ , which lists the author block "Microsoft Research AI for Science" and a "Code" button pointing to https://github.com/microsoft/HybriDNA - that repository returns 404 "Not Found" from the GitHub API, so the only official artifact locator is dead. Three weight repos now exist on Hugging Face - Mishamq/HybriDNA-300M (created 2026-01-15, lastModified 2026-05-05), -3B and -7B - each Apache-2.0, ungated, with model.safetensors plus custom modeling/tokenizer code, and each tagged arxiv:2502.10807 (confirmed by the HF arXiv filter, which returns exactly these three). Provenance is suggestive but unconfirmed: the HF account Mishamq has fullname "Mingqian Ma", matching the paper's first author, but its listed orgs are "umich" and "CladeTeam", not Microsoft, and no official page (project page, arXiv listing, or any Microsoft repo) links to these model repos - the arxiv tag is uploader-asserted. The model card itself does not name the authors or Microsoft. Under the prefer-HOLD rule this is ambiguous evidence, so HOLD stands; a single official link (a live microsoft/HybriDNA repo or a project-page weights link) would flip it to promote.

Code side: no licence at all - GitHub API returns "license": null for MineSelf2016/GeneMamba and the root listing has no LICENSE file.
rationale: Checked today: GitHub API metadata and root contents for MineSelf2016/GeneMamba (license null; files .gitattributes, .gitignore, README.md, ckpts, config.json, data_download, datasets, examples, figures, gene_tokenizer.json, genemamba, preprocess, pretrain, requirements.txt - no LICENSE); the GitHub README, which points to the HF repo ("For more convenient usage, please visit https://huggingface.co/mineself2016/GeneMamba") but states no licence; HF API metadata for mineself2016/GeneMamba (created 2026-03-21, lastModified 2026-03-23, ungated, model.safetensors present, cardData has NO license field and there is no license: tag); and the LICENSE file inside the HF repo, whose text is a modified, non-verbatim Apache-2.0 (deviations quoted above).
